cell_type_or_model: cultured neurons and artificial synapse assays
assay_or_perturbation: NLGN1/β-neurexin binding; neuronal localization; synapse-formation and postsynaptic differentiation assays
evidence_summary: Neuroligin-1 and β-neurexin interactions were associated with asymmetric synaptic junctions and excitatory postsynaptic specialization.
limitations: The studies do not establish a cytosolic TF relay from the adhesion pair.

assay_or_perturbation: NLGN1/NRXN2 binding; synaptic receptor organization and synapse-formation assays
evidence_summary: NLGN1/NRXN2-associated adhesion was linked to synaptic receptor organization and transmission-related function.
limitations: No terminal TF or direct intracellular signaling edge was resolved.

assay_or_perturbation: NLGN2/NRXN1β binding; inhibitory postsynaptic differentiation assays
evidence_summary: Neuroligin-2/NRXN1β adhesion was associated with inhibitory postsynaptic differentiation and synaptic transmission.
limitations: No intracellular TF relay or SCI-specific receiver-cell output was assigned.

evidence_summary: NLGN3/NRXN1β interactions were associated with mixed excitatory/inhibitory synapse-differentiation outputs.
limitations: The composite output does not identify a single terminal program or TF.
